1 Police Station- Kotwali Rudauli, District-Ayodhya (as contained in the Annexure No.
1 to the affidavit in support of the instant application and cognizance order dated 18.11.2023 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate Ayodhya, (as contained in the Annexure No. 2 to the affidavit in support of the instant application) criminal proceedings initiated on the basis of impugned charge sheet to meet the ends of justice..

On being confronted as to whether the observations made by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Rajnesh vs. Neha and another (2021) 2 SCC 324, have been complied with, learned counsel for the applicant says that he does not want to press the present application and prays that the same may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh.

entities.text: Rajnesh vs. Neha and another (2021) 2 SCC 324
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: To the aforesaid, there is no objection.
Accordingly, present revision is dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.

Office is directed to return certified copy(s) of the document(s), if any, annexed with the present application to the learned counsel for the applicant, as per rules.
